title: Harden compile and export external boundaries
summary: Plan the first hardening slice for /api/compile and export/embed boundaries: request size limit, schema validation, safer errors, and future auth/CSP/export policy hooks.

sourceRefs.summary: Prototype /api/compile endpoint that currently accepts unbounded JSON and returns compile errors as invalid request.
Server API coverage for health, missing routes, and compile response.
HTML asset compiler invoked by the endpoint.
Hosted/export readiness diagnostics that should inform export boundary policy.

expectedLearning: What minimum schema validation protects deterministic external ports without blocking local authoring.
Which security constraints belong to compile input, export artifacts, iframe policy, or deployment policy.
Whether the first implementation should be endpoint hardening or an explicit policy metadata layer.
allowedWork: Break hardening into small server, compiler, and export-policy slices.
Add focused tests for rejected oversized, malformed, and invalid document inputs.
Keep errors structured and safe for browser clients.
disallowedWork: Do not add authentication or deployment infrastructure in the first hardening slice.
Do not broaden into hosted production deployment unless a boundary test requires metadata.
Do not block local dashboard/editor workflows with policy that has no bypass path.
revisitWhen: Before external CAS/program/LSP ports or public embedded capsules rely on /api/compile.
